title: Emails » Forms Inbox
text:
## Emails » Forms Inbox
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000673655

## Forms Inbox - Admin Actions
Once inside the message, there are 4 available actions.
View
Reply
Actions (Archive & Delete)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620267/original/KcMCHDZ9sW7zm3O5UWZfNp5jkKGzH8qkSA.png?1723135576 | alt: ]

## View Full Inquiry
Opens a modal with the information related to the message being viewed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092921288/original/HbLts6ewhZqCCnjGHTWy7HQKf2yZiWvWQQ.png?1621523528 | alt: ]

## Reply to Inquiry
When clicked, it will open the Compose Email module and the system will use the " reply-contact-us " email template by default:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12162307048/original/NUSoK61ibPTiBV7sdBkiqwgF_ONO_G9Spw.png?1748993161 | alt: ]
Here is the content of the reply-contact-us email template, which can be edited under Emails >> Email Templates if needed:

## Delete Inquiry
Removes the message from the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145313246/original/8W8ZuPgCuUjDGGyiknPmrc66tvxOXF4SJg.png?1719250668 | alt: ]

## Archive
Sends the inquiry to the "Archived" folder.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620604/original/6knEgtrWQ1Q2IRF8JuHgTQJOvXxBij16vg.png?1723135891 | alt: ]

## Notes
This fields is for reminders or useful information about this inquiry.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092921199/original/A7_4jxml2kqAXaDXow2MoxjbgiASsgm8qw.png?1621523475 | alt: ]

## Toolbar Actions
The forms inquiries page includes a toolbar with different filtering options.

## Bulk Actions
The Bulk Actions drop-down menu is used to Mark new messages that have already been archived, or to Delete messages that are no longer needed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620768/original/0HETwMUx-xAYKWdoN1y9miUY7LQb_DYxzA.png?1723136044 | alt: ]

## Filter By Form
Filter by form, allows a more organized background of the inquiries submitted. More than one form can be selected at a time, and a search can be conducted to locate specific forms by running a keyword search.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155435229/original/VOqz3U4pijsHaBIUFePS6Jwyt2gAiT9QKA.png?1736954558 | alt: ]

## Display From Everyone
Fi lter by Members Only or Non-Members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620897/original/xzNdIIAY9pSdCARtrcs7dKhlFdCq7RGoeA.png?1723136226 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620878/original/XYUqEXRoOZ2pmZqRk3EGVsUANOAA3Kk7hg.png?1723136202 | alt: ]

## Filter By Status
Messages can be sorted by Any Status , New Inquiries , or Archived .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147620918/original/0rpa-ta_ovSlnQLkPLUbKzYXV_ZzggY3fw.png?1723136249 | alt: ]

## List Actions
This functionality allows for the creation of an emailing list from the search results generated on the page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147621659/original/05dWzPJW3_Ur1vuqJk88XbTSjMRz4R_8Ww.png?1723137023 | alt: ]
To learn more about how Smart Lists work, review the following article: Members » Smart Lists
Important Notes
If the website has been set to the Staging Mode, How To Activate "Staging Mode" / "Coming Soon" Splash Page As The Homepage messages submitted using this form will also show up in the Forms Inbox section of the admin.
